input: Big city good. My school wall blue. Jobs because more. More jobs. I no like crowd but bus easy. Better city.
question: Do you prefer big cities?

key_issues.message: 句子缺少主语和动词，如“Big city good”“Jobs because more”，英语中必须补出主语和be动词/实义动词。
“My school wall blue”与“是否喜欢大城市”完全无关，属于无效信息，应删除。
信息顺序混乱：先给结论，再插入无关细节，最后又重复“Better city”，缺少清晰的原因—让步—结论逻辑。
“Jobs because more”表意不清，应改为“there are more job opportunities”这类完整表达。
“I no like crowd”不符合自然英语，应为“I don't like the crowds”。

feedback.optimization_summary: 删除了与问题无关的“My school wall blue”；把碎片化表达补成完整句子；将“more jobs”明确为“more job opportunities”；用“but”连接不喜欢拥挤与公交便利的让步关系，最后用“so overall”收束结论。
feedback.final_upgraded_answer: I prefer big cities because there are more job opportunities. I don't like the crowds, but the buses are convenient, so overall I think big cities are better.
feedback.reference_answer: Honestly, not really — I'd take a smaller place any day. The thing that gets me about big cities is how long everything takes. Seeing a friend who lives twenty minutes away can eat up half your evening once you've factored in the walk, the wait and the crowds. In a smaller town, that same catch-up is a ten-minute bike ride, so you actually do it instead of putting it off. I also like bumping into the same faces — the baker, the guy at the corner shop — it makes a place feel like yours. Big cities are exciting for a weekend, but I wouldn't want to live that pace every day.
feedback.reference_angle_summary: 独立主线：以“时间成本”为核心拒绝大城市，辅以熟人感与周末对比；示例不代表用户经历。
feedback.content_diagnosis: 原回答直接给出了偏好（更喜欢大城市），但理由只有“more jobs”和“bus easy”，且中间混入无关信息“My school wall blue”。整体内容过薄，没有展开为什么工作机会重要或公交便利如何影响偏好。
feedback.structure_diagnosis: 原回答没有清晰的信息顺序：先抛出结论，再插入无关细节，然后补理由，最后重复结论。缺少连接词，句子之间逻辑跳跃。
feedback.optimization_advice: 建议保留“工作机会多”作为主因，并补充一句具体说明，例如你所在行业或专业为什么在大城市机会更多；对于“公交方便”，可以补充一两个具体例子，如通勤时间或线路覆盖。不要编造经历，只补充你真实感受到的细节。

takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 谈论城市、职业发展、搬迁原因时高频使用，比“more jobs”更具体自然。
takeaway_expressions.example: I moved here because there are more job opportunities in my field.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: opportunity 常用复数，搭配 there are more。

takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 常与 time / hours / savings 搭配。

feedback.reference_answer: Yeah, I'd say I do prefer big cities, though not everything about them appeals to me. The main draw is the sheer range of options — you can find pretty much any kind of food, job or evening class within a short train ride. I also like the fact that people are more anonymous, so you can just blend in and do your own thing. That said, the noise and the rent do wear you down after a while. So for now, big cities suit me, but I could see myself wanting somewhere quieter later on.
feedback.reference_angle_summary: 独立主线：以“选择多、匿名感”为核心偏好理由，同时承认噪音与房租的代价，最后给出随时间可能改变的态度；示例不代表用户经历。

takeaway_expressions.usage_note: draw 在这里是名词，常搭配 the main/biggest draw is...

takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 描述城市生活、社交场合或适应新环境时非常高频。

takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 常与 can/could 连用，表示能够不显眼地融入。

takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 主语通常是令人疲惫的事物，宾语是人。
